name: Ohagiwara Mami
source:
She is a miko who works at “Shigaraki Shrine,” the largest shrine in the neighboring town.  She was born into a family of priestesses and has deep ties to the shrine, but on the inside she is a lazy tanuki with a penchant for drinking, sex, and men. 

However, she is loved by everyone for her boldness in talking openly to strangers and her caring nature, and is affectionately called "Ohagi-san". She will listen to you kindly if you confide in her your problems, as long as she is not drunk.

[From [url=https://nijikaku2007.wixsite.com/kinosei]official website[/url]]
